description:
`SegmentedControl` is a horizontal bar of mutually exclusive options. Use it to switch between two to five related views or filters in the same context. Only one option is selected at a time. Give the control an accessible name with `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`. Every option needs a `value`. ```js --- type: example --- ``` ### Controlled and uncontrolled Pass `defaultValue` and let `SegmentedControl` track the selection. Or pass `value` together with `onChange` to control it yourself. `onChange` receives the event and the `value` of the option the user selected. ```js --- type: example --- const Example = () => { const [view, setView] = useState('grid') return ( setView(value)} > Selected: {view} ) } render() ``` ### Sizes The `size` prop accepts `lg` (the default), `md`, and `sm`. Use `lg` in most places, `md` in tighter layouts or secondary areas, and `sm` in compact toolbars or inline controls. ```js --- type: example ---
``` ### Text, icons, and both An option shows text with `renderLabel`, an icon with `renderIcon`, or both. Don't mix icon-only and text-only options in one control. An option with no `renderLabel` needs a `screenReaderLabel`. Without it, screen readers can't name the option. ```js --- type: example ---
} renderLabel="Grid" /> } renderLabel="List" /> } screenReaderLabel="Grid view" /> } screenReaderLabel="List view" />
``` ### Disabled Set `isDisabled` on `SegmentedControl` to disable every option. Set it on a single `SegmentedControl.Option` to disable just that one. ```js --- type: example ---
``` ### Accessibility `SegmentedControl` renders a `radiogroup` and each option is a `radio`. Give the group a name with `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`, and give every icon-only option a `screenReaderLabel`. Only the selected option (or the first enabled one, when nothing is selected) is in the tab order. The arrow keys move focus to the next or previous enabled option and select it. In right-to-left layouts, Arrow Left and Arrow Right swap. Home and End jump to the first and last enabled option. Options must be direct children of `SegmentedControl`. ### Guidelines ```js --- type: embed --- ```

children.description: The `SegmentedControl.Option` elements to render, as direct children.

value.description: The value of the selected option, which makes the component controlled.

defaultValue.description: The value of the option selected on first render when uncontrolled.

onChange.description: Called with the event and the value of the option the user selected.

size.description: The size of the control and its options.
